title: The repository declares that it stores no personal data
statement: The data handling declaration at law/security/data-handling.json MUST validate against law/schemas/data-handling.schema.json, MUST state that the repository stores no personal data with every store marked personal_data false, and the inventory data handling sensor MUST read that declaration rather than scan for personal-data columns.
rationale: ADR-SCR-0004 makes the absence of personal data a declared fact the F4 x T6 cell can read, instead of a vacuous scan of a data model that does not exist.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
